title: Vasilevo fire, July 2025
summary: EFFIS maps 5,227 ha burned in Vasilevo and dates the fire from 2025-07-17 to 2025-07-21.
Satellites recorded 1405 hotspot detections inside the mapped area on 15 of the 17 days shown, the most on 2025-07-27 (280).
The windiest day in ERA5 was 2025-07-29, averaging 10 km/h from the north-west with gusts to 34 km/h.
selection: Archive detections (MODIS and VIIRS, algorithm type 2 static sources excluded) inside the EFFIS perimeter buffered by 1.5 km, from two days before the EFFIS fire date to one day after the last detection day of the fire's run (at most 2 empty days in between), 17 days at most 21.

weather.source: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo archive API
weather.notes: Hourly values at the ERA5 cell nearest the perimeter centroid (about 25 km grid): regional weather, not the fire's own valley. Noon = 11:00 UTC; noon rain is the 24 h total up to that hour.
